description: Invite-gated actions: a RunAccess (Open | InviteOnly) run-authorization dimension orthogonal to IsPublic (discoverability), plus an ActionAccessRequest request-to-approval state machine, owner approval queue, and direct invite/revoke.
phase: Shipped across backend, SDK and frontend; three concurrency edges were reviewed, deliberately deferred, and forwarded to ops-postlaunch-hardening item 10.

shipped_evidence.note: Status was filed `pending` while the implementation was complete in all three layers; the spec body itself already described 'the shipped implementation' and its post-ship review follow-ups. Corrected on the evidence below.
authorization_chokepoint: Managers/ActionManager.cs - invite gate in LoadStartableActionAsync and ForkAsync

deferred_follow_ups.reason: All three want a status compare-and-set store primitive (mirror Core/Surreal/SurrealTransientConflict.cs), which is an ops-track concern rather than a bolt-on here.
items: Approve is not atomic across the action and request stores.
Terminal-state guard is read-check-write, not CAS.
The <=1-Pending invariant is a manager read-then-create, not a DB constraint.
